title: apiVersion forms
description: Every apiVersion form: one row per current form, with the old forms it replaces and its kinds. A reader that meets an apiVersion finds its row here, and for an old form the current one and the command that upgrades it (ADR-S15, ADR-S16).

apiVersion.description: The form the table is in, as <org>/<app>/<family>/v<n>. The table carries a version like everything written down (ADR-S15).

kind.description: Always ApiVersionForms, the kind of this table.

forms.description: The rows, one per current form. Each form and each old form is listed once, so a lookup finds exactly one row.

items.description: One current form: the app that owns it, its kinds, and the old forms it replaces.

new.description: The form an app writes now, as <org>/<app>/<family>/v<n>: the family names what holds the files, usually the folder or collection they live in (design, board, queue, log); the kind names one item in it. An app's answers keep the family app.

old.description: The old forms this one replaces, three parts as written before, like core/design/v2. A reader that meets an old form finds the row whose old list holds it.

items.description: One old form, three parts as written before, like core/design/v2.

app.description: The product ID of the app that owns the shape, the app whose upgrade command moves files to this form.

kinds.description: The kinds written with this form, so a reader knows what to expect under it. "*" stands for every kind the design's Definitions declare, so a design's kinds are open. An app's answer row lists that app's own answer kinds; mankit's shared answers (Link, ServerList, StoppedList, QueueList, Server) come with every app's answer apiVersion and are not repeated per app.

items.description: One kind written with this form, or "*" for every kind the design declares.

note.description: What the form holds and who reads it, in plain words for people.

upgrade.description: For a row with old forms: hubman migrate <app> <folder>, the command that upgrades files of an old form to this one, one level at a time (ADR-S16).
